 CORAM : R.G. AVACHAT, J.
DATE : DECEMBER 17, 2019 PER COURT :-
 Heard.

2. Leave to correct some lines in t application.
3. Issue notice to the respondent, returnable on 10.01.2020.

Learned APP waives notice for the respondent.
4. Till next date, in the event of arrest in connection with Crime No.453 of 2019 registered with 2 7-ABA.1589-19 Nanded Rural Police Station, Dist. Nanded, for the offences punishable under Sections 328, 188, 272, 273 read with Section 34 of Indian Penal Code and under Sections 26(2)(iv),
27, 23, 30(2)(a) and 59 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, the applicant be released on executing P.R. Bond in the sum of Rs.15,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Thousand) with one surety in the like amount.
